title: The Counter That Lost Requests
subtitle: A million increments produce a smaller number

brief.narrative: Multiple threads execute read-increment-write on shared state without synchronization. Interleavings cause increments to overwrite each other.
symptoms: Shared Counter metrics diverge from the service-level symptom
The problem reproduces only under the triggering workload
Logs contain enough evidence to distinguish cause from consequence
brief.objective: Identify the root cause, select a production-safe fix, and explain the trade-off.
